record.bible_text: And Jacob<WH03290> dwelt<WH03427><WTH8799> in the land<WH0776> wherein his father<WH01> was a stranger<WH04033>, in the land<WH0776> of Canaan<WH03667>. <RF>wherein...: Heb. of his father's sojournings<Rf>

And Joseph<WH03130> dreamed<WH02492><WTH8799> a dream<WH02472>, and he told<WH05046><WTH8686> <FI>it<Fi> his brethren<WH0251>: and they hated<WH08130><WTH8800> him yet the more<WH03254><WTH8686>.

And a certain man<WH0376> found him<WH04672><WTH8799>, and, behold, <FI>he was<Fi> wandering<WH08582><WTH8802> in the field<WH07704>: and the man<WH0376> asked him<WH07592><WTH8799>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, What seekest<WH01245><WTH8762> thou?

And when they saw<WH07200><WTH8799> him afar off<WH07350>, even before he came near<WH07126><WTH8799> unto them, they conspired<WH05230><WTH8691> against him to slay<WH04191><WTH8687> him.

And Reuben<WH07205> heard<WH08085><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> , and he delivered<WH05337><WTH8686> him out of their hands<WH03027>; and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Let us not kill<WH05221><WTH8686><WH05315> him.

And it came to pass, when Joseph<WH03130> was come<WH0935><WTH8804> unto his brethren<WH0251>, that they stript<WH06584><WTH8686><WH0853> Joseph<WH03130> out of<WH0854> his coat<WH03801>, <FI>his<Fi> coat<WH03801> of <FI>many<Fi> colours<WH06446> that <FI>was<Fi> on him; <RF>colours: or, pieces<Rf>
And they took<WH03947><WTH8799> him, and cast<WH07993><WTH8686> him into a pit<WH0953>: and the pit<WH0953> <FI>was<Fi> empty<WH07386>, <FI>there was<Fi> no water<WH04325> in it.

And they sat down<WH03427><WTH8799> to eat<WH0398><WTH8800> bread<WH03899>: and they lifted up<WH05375><WTH8799> their eyes<WH05869> and looked<WH07200><WTH8799>, and, behold, a company<WH0736> of Ishmeelites<WH03459> came<WH0935><WTH8802> from Gilead<WH01568> with their camels<WH01581> bearing<WH05375><WTH8802> spicery<WH05219> and balm<WH06875> and myrrh<WH03910>, going<WH01980><WTH8802> to carry <FI>it<Fi> down<WH03381><WTH8687> to Egypt<WH04714>.

And Judah<WH03063> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto his brethren<WH0251>, What profit<WH01215> <FI>is it<Fi> if we slay<WH02026><WTH8799> our brother<WH0251>, and conceal<WH03680><WTH8765> his blood<WH01818>?

Come<WH03212><WTH8798>, and let us sell<WH04376><WTH8799> him to the Ishmeelites<WH03459>, and let not our hand<WH03027> be upon him; for he <FI>is<Fi> our brother<WH0251> <FI>and<Fi> our flesh<WH01320>. And his brethren<WH0251> were content<WH08085><WTH8799>. <RF>were...: Heb. hearkened<Rf>

Then there passed<WH05674><WTH8799> by Midianites<WH04084> merchantmen<WH0582><WH05503><WTH8802>; and they drew<WH04900><WTH8799> and lifted up<WH05927><WTH8686> Joseph<WH03130> out of the pit<WH0953>, and sold<WH04376><WTH8799> Joseph<WH03130> to the Ishmeelites<WH03459> for twenty<WH06242> <FI>pieces<Fi> of silver<WH03701>: and they brought<WH0935><WTH8686> Joseph<WH03130> into Egypt<WH04714>.
And Reuben<WH07205> returned<WH07725><WTH8799> unto the pit<WH0953>; and, behold, Joseph<WH03130> <FI>was<Fi> not in the pit<WH0953>; and he rent<WH07167><WTH8799> his clothes<WH0899>.
